notes.title: Good Bye Frame (?)
notes.content:
Hello @everyone , and good bye to frame (?) - let me explain
A new game changing update has been pushed to FRAIM.
Here are some of the things that were changed:

- The inner frame was removed from the game, there is now only one frame in the game. Feels much cleaner.
- Rhythm spawn mode was removed, it was almost not played by anyone, and rhythm shot is the direction of the game right now.
- A collapsing circle was added to the game, it helps to shoot down the target more accurately.
- You now get more points when you shoot the target accurately.
- When you hit a target, you will see how well you performed and the amount of points that you have received
- There is a bar at the top of the screen that shows your score, accuracy, and streak during the game.
- New algorithm for the spawn position, it now spawns the targets in a way more thought of instead of being completely random. It is important in order to fix issues where targets use to get in the way of others

And more small surprises inside the game.
Check it out and let me know what you think! 
I personally think that the game has improved A LOT with this update 🥳 🎉 ❤️‍🔥

notes.title: Community beatmaps, now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone , the most important update ever has just dropped into FRAIM! community maps are finally available!     
Here's some information about the update:

-The second album is free for everyone now, if you have purchased it before you got the custom maps option for free
-The custom maps option is selling for a crazy discount right now (55% off for a limited time)
-If you want to add more maps to the game, just press the workshop button at the top and subscribe to maps created by our community members
-If you want to create beatmaps, look into create-maps-tutorial , it's pretty fast and easy to do - it's even pretty fun!
-Create beatmaps and share their workshop link in share-new-maps  to get a discord role of beatmapper
-There are currently only 2 custom maps that were created by me, but I have spoken to some community members and I believe that we will have A LOT of crazy maps really soon.

Let me know what you think, happy new year, and.. Enjoy!!!

notes.title: FRAIM Version 0.9.1.0 is live
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 0.9.1.0

Here are the new features:
[b]Settings[/b]
-Added option to change monitor
-Added option to change resolution
-Added option to turn on/off vsync
-Added option to change fullscreen mode
-Added option to invert mouse
[b]Gameplay[/b]
-The environment is now reactive and shines a little when a new target spawns
[b]UI[/b]
-Every player will now have to go through a short tutorial, as I believe that many did not understand much about the settings and the override mode
-The scrollwheel now reduces/increases volume less per step, which allows more precise tuning

As for the color-blind mode, creating those filter will require more time than I assumed so I will add this option in the next updates, if you're a color-blind; I'm sorry.
